scientific.integrity: The local bivariate sign-amplitude moment is derived by an explicit one-dimensional Gaussian integral. The AR(1) propagation is proved from the Gaussian Markov property and stationarity, and the finite covariance follows by finite geometric summation. A standalone checker numerically replays the integral and independently compares the closed form with the unsimplified local-kernel sum.
scientific.limitations: Exact only for a stationary mean-zero Gaussian AR(1) process and uncentered quadratic energy. No theorem is asserted for centered sample variance, non-Gaussian autoregressions, nonzero thresholds, or general stationary Gaussian covariance sequences. Older signal-processing literature under alternate notation remains a residual originality risk.

title: Zero-crossing count has exact opposite-sign covariance with Gaussian AR(1) energy
